name: SD: Web services (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: A small web system, measured every second: requests in flight at five services, messages waiting in a queue, jobs in progress at a worker pool, and the tokens left in the catalog's rate limiter. The data is generated by a system dynamics model (the ground truth is in sd-services/truth.model.json), so discovery can be checked exactly. Tests links: one service calling others. Tests a co-flow too: every call the API makes to the catalog spends a rate-limit token, and the limiter refills its bucket at a limited pace, so in a traffic spike the tokens run low and calls to the catalog are held back.
